tickets.recommended_action: Today, rotating specialist inspect NDE bearing, alignment and balance; correct per findings and verify vibration against limits. Obtain source-required attention today. Repeat spectrum and inspect bearing.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The six-week rise, growing 1x component and unplateaued trend are strong progression evidence, but not proof of imminent or confirmed function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: This single main gas export train has no spare or workaround; a trip sends the platform to recycle and cuts production within an hour.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first weekly test start, then started after 8 seconds and delivered rated pressure; recurrent starting-system concerns degrade firewater availability, while partner delivery capability is uncertain.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection engineer to inspect batteries/air, repair as found, and verify first-attempt start and rated pressure. Check recorded deviation status. Retest first-attempt start and pressure. Test FW-8101 pressure and flow.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A required start-on-demand function already failed during testing. The later successful start and rated discharge confirm delivery once running but do not negate the first-attempt failure.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would degrade a safety-critical firewater protection layer. FW-8101 started but later produced 9.2 barg against 11 barg design with flow unmeasured, so capable redundancy cannot be credited.
